about.description:
earthborne.build is a fan-made deck builder for Earthborne Rangers by Earthborne Games. It is based on arkham.build, created by Felix Spöttel. This app is not produced, endorsed, or supported by, or affiliated with Earthborne Games.

The source code of this project is available on GitHub. Feedback and bug reports are welcome via GitHub issues.

All artwork and illustrations are the intellectual property of their respective creators.

background_type_description.artisan: Artisans are skilled craftspeople who work with tools and support equipped gear, both their own and other Rangers'.
background_type_description.forager: Foragers know the Valley's plants deeply. Their cards key off flora and can use it as a resource in ways other backgrounds cannot.
background_type_description.shepherd: Shepherds tend ironwool flocks and have a natural affinity for animals. Their cards often affect beings and help pacify predators without violence.
background_type_description.talespinner: Talespinners study story, song, and spoken tradition. Their cards soothe fatigue, manipulate the fatigue stack, and support Rangers with tale moments.
background_type_description.traveler: Travelers are at home on the Valley's footpaths. Their cards primarily revolve around making the most of moment cards.

specialty_type_description.artificer: Artificers are inventors who work with tech and gear. Their cards help Rangers find, play, and enhance equipment.
specialty_type_description.conciliator: Conciliators resolve conflict through presence and de-escalation. Their cards pacify beings, protect Rangers, and support aid efforts.
specialty_type_description.explorer: Explorers push into unknown terrain. Their cards improve tests, navigate path cards, and keep Rangers moving through the Valley.
specialty_type_description.shaper: Shapers are attuned to the Valley's ancient forces. Their cards interact with conduits, manipulate manifestations, and read the challenge ahead.
specialty_type_description.spirit_speaker: Spirit Speakers commune with the Valley's unseen spirits. Their cards channel spiritspeak and build deep connections with the land.

service.title: Service
service.body: earthborne.build provides tools for Earthborne Rangers deck building, campaign tracking, and related community features. The service is a fan project and is not produced, endorsed by, or affiliated with Earthborne Games.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: You may use earthborne.build only if you are legally allowed to agree to these Terms.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for activity under your account. You must provide accurate account identifiers and may not use another person's account without permission.

user_content.title: User-generated content
user_content.body: You are responsible for the content you create or publish. Private content is only intended for your account. Public contributions (such as shared decks and deck guides) may be visible to other users and may remain available after account deletion in anonymized form.

acceptable_use.title: Acceptable use
acceptable_use.body: You must not misuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, disrupt the service, upload unlawful content, harass others, impersonate others, or infringe the rights of others. To report abuse, contact sergiu@sergiu.org with the relevant URL or ID and a short description.

moderation.title: Moderation and admin actions
moderation.body: We may review content or accounts, remove or restrict content, and suspend or delete accounts when needed to operate the service, prevent abuse, or enforce these Terms.

account_deletion.title: Account deletion
account_deletion.body: You may delete your account at any time in the account settings. Private user content is deleted, public contributions are anonymized, and backup copies expire through the normal backup retention process.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: The service is provided without a guarantee of uninterrupted availability. Features may change, be limited, or be discontinued.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by applicable law, earthborne.build is provided without warranties and liability is limited to legally required cases.

governing_law.title: Governing law
governing_law.body: These Terms are governed by Swiss law, subject to mandatory consumer protection rules that may apply in your country.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these Terms when the service or legal requirements change. The current version is published on this page. The Privacy Policy explains how data is processed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how earthborne.build processes personal data.

data.title: Data we process
data.body: We process only the data needed to operate earthborne.build: email address, username, password hash, session identifiers, content you sync to your account (decks, campaigns, folders, settings, and achievements), and IP addresses in server logs. If you contact us or report abuse, we process your message, related content or account identifiers, and timestamps.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal bases
purposes.body: We process account, login, profile, sync, and account deletion data to provide earthborne.build under the Terms of Service. We process security, abuse-prevention, debugging, and service email data based on our legitimate interests under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and, where applicable, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: We use a single session cookie for authentication. We use IndexedDB in your browser for local user data and preferences. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We use Plausible Analytics to measure aggregate site usage. Plausible is a privacy-focused, cookieless service hosted in the EU; it does not store personal data, persistent identifiers, or IP addresses.

third_party.title: Third-party content
third_party.body: User-generated content may contain external links or images. External images may load automatically from third-party servers, which may process technical data under their own privacy policies.

processors.title: Processors
processors.body: We use Resend (Resend, Inc., USA) to deliver transactional email such as verification and password reset messages. The service itself is hosted on privately operated infrastructure in Switzerland.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.body: Email delivery through Resend may involve processing outside Switzerland and the EU/EEA. We rely on adequacy decisions where applicable and Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent safeguards where required.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Account data is kept while your account exists. If you delete your account, private user content is deleted immediately and public contributions are anonymized. Server logs are retained for up to 30 days. Backups are retained for up to 90 days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Subject to applicable data protection law, you may request access, export, correction, deletion, restriction, or objection to processing. Data export (Settings → Backup), email and username changes, password reset, and account deletion are available as self-service features. For manual requests, contact sergiu@sergiu.org. You may also complain to your competent data protection authority.

security.title: Security
security.body: We use measures such as HTTPS, password hashing, hashed session tokens, and access controls to protect user data.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy when the service or legal requirements change. The current version is published on this page.
